title: [202012 platform_tests][9332] test_show_platform_syseeprom fails - API and show output differ
author: tjchadaga
body:

#### Description

<!--
     Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->
'show platform syseeprom' differs from the output retrieved from API using test_get_system_eeprom_info for 0xFD field

```
show platform syseeprom 
TlvInfo Header:
   Id String:    TlvInfo
   Version:      1
   Total Length: 170
TLV Name             Code Len Value
-------------------- ---- --- -----
Product Name         0x21   9 Z9332F-ON
Part Number          0x22   6 04CN21
Serial Number        0x23  20 TH04CN21CET0004K0214
Base MAC Address     0x24   6 C8:F7:50:ED:7C:C1
Manufacture Date     0x25  19 05/13/2020 01:43:36
Device Version       0x26   1 1
Label Revision       0x27   3 A01
Platform Name        0x28  30 x86_64-dellemc_z9332f_d1508-r0
ONIE Version         0x29   5 0.0.3
MAC Addresses        0x2A   2 384
Manufacturer         0x2B   5 CET00
Manufacture Country  0x2C   2 TH
Vendor Name          0x2D   8 Dell EMC
Diag Version         0x2E   5 0.5.1
Service Tag          0x2F   7 9DRXCW2
Vendor Extension     0xFD   4
CRC-32               0xFE   4 0x5E7C686F
```

API output:
```
      syseeprom_info:
        "0x21": "Z9332F-ON"
        "0x22": "04CN21"
        "0x23": "TH04CN21CET0004K0214"
        "0x24": "C8:F7:50:ED:7C:C1"
        "0x25": "05/13/2020 01:43:36"
        "0x26": "1"
        "0x27": "A01"
        "0x28": "x86_64-dellemc_z9332f_d1508-r0"
        "0x29": "0.0.3"
        "0x2A": "384"
        "0x2B": "CET00"
        "0x2C": "TH"
        "0x2D": "Dell EMC"
        "0x2E": "0.5.1"
        "0x2F": "9DRXCW2"
        "0xFD": "674"
        "0xFE": "0x5E7C686F"
```


#### Steps to reproduce the issue:
1. Run platform_tests/test_show_platform.py::test_show_platform_syseeprom

#### Describe the results you received:
test_show_platform_syseeprom returns
Failed: System EEPROM info is incorrect - for '0xFD', rcvd '', expected '674' on 'str2-z9332f-01'

Testbed facts have been updated based on API output

#### Describe the results you expected:
No failure and API and show output should match

#### Why I did it

To make values returned by 'get_system_eeprom_info' compliant with eeprom_tlvinfo.TlvInfoDecoder. 
Fixes #8573 

#### How I did it

Use eeprom_tlvinfo.TlvInfoDecoder's decoder method for all TLVs.

#### How to verify it

Verify that `platform_tests/cli/test_show_platform.py::test_show_platform_syseeprom` reports Success.
Logs: [UT_logs.txt](https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/files/7135694/UT_logs.txt)
